meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер
на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: звать на помощь = to call for help
как тебя зовут? = what's your name? меня зовут ... = my name is ...

передать.gloss: to pass on, to hand over

meanings.en: to pass on, to hand over, to give

examples.trans: Please pass on my regards to your mum.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

meanings.note: only when answering or making a phone call
polite, or to several people; the first в is silent

звонить.gloss: to call, to phone; to ring

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine
уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: чуть не + verb: я чуть не упал = I nearly fell
goes right before the word it negates

улететь.gloss: to fly away, to depart by plane

meanings.en: to fly away, to fly out, to depart by air

examples.trans: What do you mean you didn't fly out?
Our plane has already flown out.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.trans: And they warned me very strictly!
